verification.scope: Driver-aware create disk admission; no Docker allocation and no native Windows runtime claim

contract.vfsCreateAllowance: 2 * configured image virtual size; init and writable layer copies
contract.overlayCreateAllowance: 1 * configured image virtual size for exact overlay, overlay2, overlayfs, fuse-overlayfs drivers
contract.unknownDriver: wait with execution_disk_estimate_unavailable, no lease allocated
contract.demand: checked (pending unobserved allocations + proposed child) * create allowance + configured disk reserve
contract.pendingAcrossRestart: retained through shared durable leases; same lease not double-charged
contract.observedAllocation: already reflected in observed disk free; not charged as a pending copy

limitations: Create allowance is an estimate, not a quota or lifetime bound on arbitrary worker writes.
Host disk changes include unrelated activity; implementation source proves VFS duplication, not attribution of all observed writes.
Backing filesystem/VM observation accuracy is a separate probe contract.
The synthetic four-project fixture explicitly identifies overlay2; this change does not alter earlier retained benchmark evidence.

sourceScope: Only the five selected source hashes in the original receipt; not a full compilation manifest.
